save_data_tensor_or_dict: save a PyTorch tensor or dictionary under a unique ID and name for later retrieval
list_all_names_uid: list all saved data names associated with a given unique ID
load_all_data_uid: load all previously saved data for a given unique ID as a dictionary
compare_data_dicts: compare two data dictionaries and return matched and mismatched nested keys
set_default_save_path: set the default file system path where debug_utils saves and loads data
